title: Gyarados Can Rage for a Whole Month
premise: Gyarados can stay enraged for a whole month, stopping only after it demolishes everything around it.
audiencePromise: See how a recorded whole-month rampage ends only after Gyarados demolishes everything around it.
openLoop: What finally makes Gyarados's month-long rampage stop?
payoff: Gyarados has recorded rampages lasting a whole month before it stops.

voice.instructions: Speak like a knowledgeable fan revealing something alarming. Start clipped and urgent, then build steady pressure through the calendar reveal. Stress whole month and demolished. End with a playful challenge.

scenes.headline: A WHOLE MONTH OF RAGE
scenes.narration: Gyarados can rage for a whole month.
scenes.caption: A WHOLE MONTH OF RAGE

scenes.headline: THE RAMPAGE KEEPS GOING
scenes.narration: Pokédex records say its rampages can last a whole month.
scenes.caption: RAMPAGES CAN LAST A WHOLE MONTH

scenes.headline: IT STOPS AFTER DEMOLITION
scenes.narration: It does not calm down until everything around it is demolished.
scenes.caption: IT STOPS ONLY AFTER DEMOLITION

scenes.headline: NOTHING STAYS SAFE
scenes.narration: And it burns everything down with intensely hot flames.
scenes.caption: INTENSELY HOT FLAMES

scenes.headline: THE CALENDAR KEEPS FLIPPING
scenes.narration: A whole month is the recorded length of its rampage.
scenes.caption: THE CALENDAR FLIPS UNTIL NOTHING REMAINS
